root.name: アメリカン・ウォーター・ワークス

companies.name: エッセンシャル・ユーティリティーズ

relations.text: 2025年10月26日に、全株式交換による経営統合の合併契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On October 26, 2025, the parent company signed a stock-for-stock merger agreement

source.label: アメリカン・ウォーター・ワークス 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: On October 26, 2025, parent company entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Essential Merger Agreement”) with Essential Utilities, Inc. (“Essential”) to combine the two companies in a stock-for-stock transaction.

relations.text: 買収を進める際の、最大級の民間競合として名前が挙がる
relations.text_en: Named among the largest investor-owned competitors when pursuing acquisitions

source.label: アメリカン・ウォーター・ワークス 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: When pursuing acquisitions, the Company’s largest investor-owned competitors, based on a comparison of operating revenues and population served, include Essential, American States Water Company and California Water Service Group.
